LibreDB Studio, an Open-Source Database Editor, Is Now Listed in the Official Documentation of Ten Database Projects

Istanbul, Turkiye--(Newsfile Corp. - October 1, 2026) - LibreDB Studio, an open-source database editor that runs in the browser, is now listed in the official documentation or ecosystem pages of ten database projects: PostgreSQL, Redis, ClickHouse, MariaDB, Trino, Apache Cloudberry (Incubating), Yug
